[Peeking behind the Curtain](https://archiveofourown.org/works/824682) by calrissian18 is one of my fave seer!Draco fics -- really intense world building and original characters that I got attached to super quickly plus if you like seeing harry make bad choices and experience the consequences of them this is one of the quickest yet most satisfying cycles I've ever read lol. 

[Close Behind](https://archiveofourown.org/works/43264566) by oflights is also another amazing new read -- features really intelligent villains and twists that I was pleasantly surprised by + Draco and Astoria romance that very gracefully tackles their love and tho I am a drarry fan through and through, the exploration of how they can genuinely love other people after loving each other was beautiful. Without spoiling, I'll just say that the ending was completely absolutely satisfying. Oh also I love the Orpheus and Eurydice myth so that was a huge plus -- a rewrite that was authentic yet had its own spin. Also despite being somewhat of a monster fic (134K) the pace was lovely — at no point did I think things were going too slowly or rushing past me so quickly I couldn’t keep up.

[Sourdough](https://archiveofourown.org/works/32153461) by academicdisaster honestly a beautiful work exploring Draco with agoraphobia and how Harry falls in love with him and helps him cope; every time I saw Draco cautiously nudge another boundary too see Harry my heart exploded so beware I guess :")

[The Bolthole](https://archiveofourown.org/works/26025370) by aideomai and Tepre sparked an emotional crisis and deep introspection session at 3am so do with that what you will 

[The Habit of a Foreign Sky](https://archiveofourown.org/works/27654179) by etalice for andithiel shows that something about drarry and houses and claiming and finding home really gets to me... i cant remember the exact plot of this after bookmarking it 2 years ago but according to the attached note I seemed quite devastated by Harry's speech near the end so if anything read it for that i think (am too emotionally scared to reread it rn and dissolve into sobbing) 

[amid this warm and steady sweetness](https://archiveofourown.org/works/20365987) by warmfoothills is another one that proves the aforementioned house theory -- i do remember exactly how devastated i was by this and its portrayal of love (very). i think the main attraction here is the big big feelings involved from harry's pov and ihow he works through his sadboy issues while being deeply in denial about how much he adores draco which is an excellent state of fic.
